subject: S06 re-review 2 done (9498ba7): cache writes never reject and count in data-learn-idle; shared settle() loads all fonts; chapters_media buckets from app_config + eviction + single-flight; PROGRESS deferrals; phone-390/firefox-412 x3 66/66, smoke x2 88/88
body:
S06 re-review round 2: the three remaining items are integrated on claude/naadi-shared at 9498ba7 (my commit was 4957a91 before the rebase).

## 1. WebKit "Context is stopped" (MAJOR)
- **Cause** (from the reviewer's trace): a `Cache API operation failed: Context is stopped` pageError is raised during `page.goto`. The offline cache put was still in flight when the page left.
- **Fix in `offlineCache.writeOffline`:**
  - It is no longer async. It returns the chain `caches.open().then(put).catch().finally()`, so the rejection handler is attached synchronously to the whole chain and the function never rejects.
  - Pending writes are counted, with `pendingOfflineWrites()`, `subscribeOfflineWrites()` and `useOfflineWritesIdle()`.
- **Idle signal:** the reader and the course map now expose `data-learn-page` and `data-learn-idle`. On the reader, idle means no reading-position save is scheduled or in flight, and no cache write is pending. On the map, it means no cache write is pending. This replaces `data-position-idle`.
- **Test side:** learn.spec waits for quiet (`settle()` plus no `[data-learn-page]:not([data-learn-idle])`) before every navigation, every reload and going offline. It does this through `go()`, `reload()` and `quiet()`. Every `page.goto` in learn.spec now goes through `go()`; the two gated loading-state tests use `{ heading: false }`.
- **Unit tests:** a write cut off mid-put resolves and the pending count returns to 0, with subscriber events [1, 0]; a value that cannot be serialised is never counted.

## 2. Firefox font race (MAJOR)
- `apps/web/e2e/fixtures.ts` now exports `loadAllFonts(page)` and `settle(page)`. `settle()` loads every face and unicode-range subset, then waits for `document.fonts.status === "loaded"`.
- learn.spec uses it after every navigation and in `quiet()` before the next one.
- I posted a note to all agents: 20261116T223044-seg06-reader-026148.

## 3. chapters_media (MINOR, item 12)
- Bucket names come from `app_config.storage` through `configured_buckets()` (validated `StorageBuckets`); they can also be passed in.
- Expired signed-URL entries are evicted on every signing pass, and the cache is capped at 4,096 entries (the soonest-expiring are dropped first).
- `_lock` is gone, and no lock is held across the network sign call. Each object has one in-flight future (single flight), and waiters await it through `asyncio.shield`. A `finally` block settles every future even when the signing request is cancelled, so no waiter is stranded.
- Unit tests cover:
  - bucket names read from the config;
  - renamed buckets being honoured and the old names refused;
  - eviction;
  - 5 concurrent requests for one object making one sign call, while a second object signs concurrently (so the call is not serialised);
  - cancellation of the signing request leaving the waiter with None and no hang.
- `docs/PROGRESS.md` has a new "Deferrals" section: "Weak areas only" waits for S11's mastery model, and "High-yield only" needs a high-yield flag in the content schema and seed.

## Tests
- **Integrate gate:** the full CI lint · typecheck · unit · drift · build job. That is `pnpm lint` (biome on the whole repo, ruff check and format), `pnpm typecheck` (tsc and mypy), `pnpm test`, pytest without db and live tests, `gen:contracts` and `gen:requirements` with no diff, and `pnpm build`. All green:
  - vitest: web 146, ui 27, shared 122, ink 51;
  - pytest unit: 515 passed.
- Courses tests (unit and DB) on the local stack: 53 passed.
- **e2e, learn.spec, `--retries=0`:**
  - webkit-phone-390 and firefox-phone-412, `--repeat-each=3`: 66/66 passed. A first attempt with 6 failures ran against a stale dist that did not yet carry `data-learn-idle`; after rebuilding: 66/66.
  - smoke set (webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440), `--repeat-each=2`: 88/88 passed.
